items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: So we got Farz, Ben Pollack was on the drums, Santo Pecora played the trombone, and Eddie Miller played the sax.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember those black label vocalions, gold printing on them.

So we got Farz, Ben Pollack was on the drums, Santo Pecora played the trombone, and Eddie Miller played the sax. Eddie Condon played the guitar. And a fellow by the name of Al Hort was a piano player, a Negro, but he was a fine piano player. So to make a long story short, we made a session, and we made a good session at that time, and I got a contract.

items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: So I brought Sharky there with me, because Sharky was playing with me at the Marathon, see.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know where that is.

So I brought Sharky there with me, because Sharky was playing with me at the Marathon, see. And then we went to the Dream Land, and from there, when I got finished there, I went to the Preview. Remember the Preview? On Ken Allen and Wright. Yeah. Yeah, right by the...
Meal and Minutes. Meal and Minutes. Yeah.
